description: Use when the user asks about one specific open offer on the XP marketplace -- whether it filled, how much of it is left, or 'did that offer get my tickets'. Returns the offer at any status along with the fills it has taken, so it answers for filled and rescinded offers that `list_my_open_offers` does not show. Requires auth.

open_offer_id.description: The standing_bid_id of an open offer, from list_my_open_offers.

name: get_open_offer
title: Open Offer Detail
